purpose: Refit the T250 four-source paper-data model after collapsing technical replicate rows before laboratory-held-out fitting, selection and evaluation.

target_universe.availability_rule: A common target contributes only when the audited source map records a finite strictly positive author value; blank, explicit zero and NA states remain missing.

technical_replicate_policy.fit_unit: one collapsed target observation per source/batch/canonical-target group
technical_replicate_policy.target_value: arithmetic mean of the source-local rank percentiles for available positive technical replicate rows
technical_replicate_policy.feature_value: the release-fixed sequence feature vector for the canonical accession
technical_replicate_policy.missingness: do not impute absent technical replicate rows; average only observed positive rows in a registered duplicate group

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the release-fixed sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on amino-acid composition features only
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.cluster: held-out measurement batch; no donor independence is inferred from laboratory count
uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: Report measurement-batch count and avoid donor-level effective-n claims.

negative_control.alpha_policy: re-run grouped nested alpha selection for every permuted development set
negative_control.interpretation: Selection-aware permutation null after technical-replicate collapse; it is not independent external validation.

estimand_boundary: The primary score is the equal-weight mean of source-local measurement-batch Spearman values after technical-replicate collapse. Report raw rows (783), fit observations (671), measurement-batch clusters, source/laboratory anchors and unresolved donor-level effective n separately.
claim_boundary: This is an exploratory four-source strict-common-target portability refit conditioned on a pre-frozen all-source target-availability intersection. It addresses technical replicate weighting before fitting but does not establish four independent biological cohorts, donor-level generalization, evaluator lockbox performance, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
